resizes ur Tool to whatever size you change it to

to change ur size 

edit this handle.Size = Vector3.new(567, 567, 567)
the (567, 567, 567) edit those
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local tool = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

if tool then
    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if handle then
        handle.Size = Vector3.new(567, 567, 567)
    end
end
